title.narrative: WWH TIP : Creating a Teaching Case Study about the Targeted Instruction Program (TIP)

description.narrative: The scope of work is to develop a teaching case study based on the implementation and scaling of the Targeted Instruction Program (TIP), a remedial math intervention tested by LEAPS in Pakistan. The case study will use TIP as a real-world example to help students, practitioners, and executive education participants understand the challenges of translating evidence into policy, implementing programs effectively, and taking them to scale.The case study is expected to cover the program’s context and problem, the key education actors involved, implementation constraints and opportunities, and discussion questions for learners. The work also includes producing a detailed case-study outline and a final completed teaching case, as well as participating in coordination meetings and learning activities connected to the What Works Hub for Global Education.
